16. Important notes & your responsibilities#

HDX Inspect stores your data on your own devices and in your organisation's own Google Drive. That keeps the data under your control — and it leaves a few things with you. Please read these.

  • Control who can open the shared folder. Roles and permissions apply inside the app. Anyone who can open the shared Google Drive folder can reach the data in it, so share it only with the people and accounts your organisation trusts with all of it, and remove access when someone leaves.
  • Use strong passwords, one account per person. Do not share logins, and deactivate accounts that are no longer needed.
  • Sync regularly. Work that has not synced exists only on that one device (chapter 14).
  • Keep a backup. Sync is not a backup; arrange a regular copy of the shared folder to a second location.
  • Lost or retired devices. Remove the device's Google account from the shared folder in Google Drive. A device wipe clears the device itself, not your Drive (§13.11).
  • Certificates and documents are locked in the app once finalised. They are corrected only by void, supersede or cancellation invoice. HDX Inspect is a working tool, not a certified archive: the app does not stop someone with access to the shared folder from changing or deleting files there.
  • Sharing is up to you. The app sends no e-mail. It records that you handed a certificate or document off; it cannot confirm that the recipient received it.
  • Inspections remain your professional responsibility. The app records what the inspector enters. Whether an inspection meets the legal requirements — including the inspector's qualification — is for your organisation to ensure.
  • Invoices: the app checks, it does not advise. It refuses to finalise an invoice with missing mandatory details, but it does not verify UID numbers, does not choose the VAT treatment, is not a cash register and produces no structured e-invoice. Record retention and your accounting remain with you (§12.8).

This manual describes how the app behaves. It is not legal or tax advice.

17. Troubleshooting & FAQ#

I can't sign in.

  • Check the username and password. After five wrong passwords in a row the account is locked on that device for 15 minutes.
  • If you were given a temporary password, the first sign-in asks you to set a new one.
  • If your account was deactivated, an administrator must reactivate it (Settings → Accounts & devices).

I forgot my password.

Ask an administrator to reset it in Settings → Accounts & devices → Reset password. They will give you a temporary password to change at your next sign-in. If the reset was made on another device, tap Trouble signing in? → Check for account updates on the sign-in screen first (§2.4).

How do I delete my account?

Open Settings → Danger zone → Delete my account and confirm with your password. Your login is removed from every device; the inspection records and certificates you created stay with the organisation. It cannot be undone. If you are the last active administrator, a second administrator account must be created first. An administrator can also delete another person's account from Settings → Accounts & devices (§13.8).

How do I set up a second device, or use the same account on more than one device?

On the new device choose Join an existing store, connect the same Google account and folder, let the data sync, then sign in with your normal account (§2.3). Do not create a new account with the same username — that would be a different account.

The sync badge is red / sync isn't working.

  • Open Settings → Synchronisation and tap Details to read the error.
  • A brief loss of connection clears by itself: the app retries every few minutes and as soon as the device is back online.
  • Common causes of a lasting problem: no internet; the shared folder cannot be reached or written to; the Google Drive storage is full; or the Google connection has expired and an administrator must connect again.
  • Use Settings → Drive store → Re-check Drive store to check the folder and sync again. Do not use Set up Drive store automatically to clear a sync error (§13.6).
  • Your work is safe on the device and will sync once the problem is resolved.

Sync says “File not found”.

  • This is usually temporary and the app retries by itself. If it persists, use Re-check Drive store (§13.6).
  • If the message names your Drive store folder itself, restore the folder from the Google Drive trash, or connect the Google account that owns it.

There are sync conflicts.

Two devices changed the same record. Open Settings → Sync conflicts, compare the values and choose Keep this device or Keep incoming (§13.7).

A certificate says “Certificate pending”.

The check is finalised but the PDF could not be created yet. Tap Retry certificate on the completion screen, or open the Dashboard, which retries by itself and shows a card with Retry now.

A certificate came out in the wrong language.

  • A certificate prints in the customer's certificate language, not the app's interface language. Set it in the customer's record (§8.1).
  • For a single check, switch the language on the Summary screen before you sign (§4.5). After signing it is fixed — correct it by voiding or superseding the certificate (§5.4–5.5).

It won't let me finalise a German (or English) certificate.

A certificate needs checklist text in its language for every item. Switch the certificate language on the Summary screen, or ask an administrator to add the missing template text (chapter 10).

How do I draw on or mark up a photo?

In a draft check, tap a photo thumbnail on the checklist item, add your marks and tap Save (§4.3). Photos can be annotated only before signing.

How do I change the app's language or switch to dark mode?

Open Settings → Appearance & language (§13.1, §13.2). Both apply to this device only and do not change certificates.

How do I change our logo or the look of the certificate?

The company name, logo, logo size, banner image, accent colour and footer are on Settings → Company profiles (§13.3). The declaration wording, photos per item and which sections appear are on Settings → Certificate settings (§13.4). Changes apply to future certificates.

The logo prints too small — or the slogan, banner or footer sits on the wrong side.

On the company profile (§13.3), pick a larger logo size, or upload the artwork as a banner image to print it across the top of the page. The slogan, the footer lines and the banner image each have left / centred / right alignment buttons under their field.

There is an HDX logo on my certificate.

A certificate's title row always carries a logo. If the company profile has none, the built-in HDX logo is printed. Upload your own logo on the profile (§13.3).

Where are my bank details on the invoice?

They print in the page footer when the company profile's footer lines are empty. If you wrote your own footer lines, add the bank details to them (§13.3).

My new quote (or invoice) disappeared.

A new document is saved only once it has a customer. Choose the customer first, then enter the lines (§12.3).

I can't finalise an invoice — it says I must sync.

Invoices and cancellation invoices are finalised online. Connect, tap Sync now, then finalise. Checks, quotes and delivery notes can be finalised offline (§12.4).

The Share / print button on an invoice is disabled.

  • A finalised invoice can be shared once it has synced. Wait for the sync badge, or tap Sync now beside the button.
  • It is also disabled for a voided document, while the PDF is still pending, and while two documents share the same number (§12.7).

Two invoices have the same number.

Decide which document stands, void the other and issue it again; the new one receives the next free number (§12.7).

I have the Billing permission but cannot edit the company profile.

Company profiles are edited with the Organisation settings permission. Ask an administrator to grant it or to make the change (§13.9).

How do I connect a different Google account?

In Settings, open the menu (⋮) of the connected Google account and choose Switch account or Disconnect (§13.6). Neither deletes anything from Google Drive.

Where do I find help or the introduction again?

Tap the ? at the top of any main screen, or open Settings → Help & about for the whole manual and Show the introduction again (§2.9).

18. Glossary#

TermMeaning
AnnotationMarks drawn on a photo (arrows, shapes, text) to point out a defect.
Banner image / taglineLetterhead artwork across the top of documents and certificates, and the slogan strip under the header of documents (§13.3).
Blocking / MinorDefect severities on a failed item. Blocking: overall Fail and reinspection. Minor: Pass with defects.
BookingOne planned customer visit, linking a customer, machines, an inspector and a time.
Cancellation invoiceThe way to undo an invoice that has been sent: a new numbered document with the negative amounts, linked to the original.
CertificateThe numbered PDF produced when a check is finalised.
Certificate languageThe language a certificate is printed in — German or English. Follows the customer and can be changed per check until it is signed.
CheckA single machine's inspection — its checklist answers, readings, work and travel, signatures and result.
Company profileThe company a certificate or document is issued under — its details, logo, colours, footer and defaults (§13.3).
ConflictThe same record changed on two devices; a person chooses which version to keep (§13.7).
DemoSample data on one device, without sync (§2.1).
Document (Beleg)A quote (Angebot), delivery note (Lieferschein), invoice (Rechnung) or cancellation invoice (Stornorechnung).
Draft (Entwurf)A document without a number that can still be edited or discarded; also an inspection that has been started but not finalised.
Drive storeThe shared Google Drive folder your organisation's devices sync through.
FinalisedSigned off and locked in the app. Corrected only by void, supersede or cancellation invoice.
Introduction / hintsThe welcome tour at first sign-in and the one-time hint on each main screen (§2.9).
Number floorThe first number to issue for a document type and year, used when moving from another system mid-year (§13.3).
PDF pendingA finalised certificate or document whose PDF has not been created yet; the app retries.
Reverse chargeA VAT treatment you choose on a document; the app then sets the lines to 0 % and prints the statutory note.
TemplateThe checklist for a machine type (or one assigned to an individual machine).
Void / SupersedeCorrections after finalisation — mark a certificate void, or replace it with a linked reissue. The original is kept in both cases.
